questions.question: Use Born-Haber cycle to calculate lattice enthalpy of NaCl given: DeltaH_f deg (NaCl) = -411, DeltaH_at(Na)=+107, DeltaH_at(Cl)=+122, IE(Na)=+496, EA(Cl)=-349 kJ/mol

points.text: DeltaH_f = DeltaH_at(Na) + DeltaH_at(Cl) + IE(Na) + EA(Cl) + LE. -411 = 107 + 122 + 496 - 349 + LE -> LE = -411 - 376 = -787 kJ/mol. Lattice enthalpy = +787 kJ/mol (endothermic to break)
